response.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_invoice_mean_price, AVG(item_count) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM per_invoice;
